title: Graffiti Punk Girl
description: A fierce female character with voluminous, flowing magenta and red hair stands in a dynamic pose against a plain gray background. She wears a red crop top, red shorts, a utility belt, red platform boots, and holds a spray paint can in her right hand while pointing forward with her left.
prompt: A confident punk girl with massive, wild flowing magenta and red hair, wearing a red leather crop top, tiny red shorts, a black utility belt with pouches, gold armbands, and tall red platform combat boots.
